prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t reliably name a single “best” lawyer for every truck-accident case — the best choice depends on the facts of your crash, your injuries, and which lawyer’s experience and approach fit your needs. I can, however, help you find a top lawyer and tell you how to evaluate them. 

How to choose a lawyer for a Dallas truck-accident case
- Relevant experience: look for attorneys who regularly handle commercial truck cases (not just general car accidents). Truck cases require knowledge of FMCSA regulations, electronic logging device (ELD) data, hours-of-service rules, and commercial carrier liability.
- Trial experience and verdicts: a lawyer who tries cases will usually negotiate better settlements. Ask about jury verdicts and large settlements in truck/crash cases.
- Credentials: Texas Board of Legal Specialization certification in Personal Injury Trial Law (if applicable), AV Preeminent/Martindale-Hubbell ratings, Super Lawyers listings, American Association for Justice membership.
- Investigation resources: the firm should routinely work with accident reconstructionists, trucking experts, medical experts, and know how to subpoena carrier records (logs, maintenance, GPS/ELD).
- Communication and team: confirm who will handle the case day-to-day, how you’ll be informed, and response times.
- Fee structure: most truck-injury lawyers work on contingency — confirm percentage, who pays litigation costs, and if you owe anything if you lose.
- Local knowledge: familiarity with Dallas courts, judges, local defense firms, and insurance adjusters is a plus.

Immediate practical steps you should take
- Get medical care and keep records.
- Preserve evidence: photos of the scene, vehicles, injuries; witness names and contact info.
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers; give only basic facts to police.
- Note the truck’s company name, USDOT/MC number, driver info, license plate.
- Keep copies of all bills, pay stubs (for lost wages), and communications.

Questions to ask when you interview a lawyer
- How many truck-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Have you handled cases with [my injury type] (e.g., spine injury, amputation, traumatic brain injury)?
- What were results for similar cases (settlement/verdict examples)?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day? How often will I get updates?
- What is your fee and how are costs handled?
- Do you have references from former clients?

How I can help right now
- If you want, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and I’ll look up top-rated Dallas truck-accident attorneys and give a short list with links and notes (based on public profiles and ratings).
- I can also draft an email or script you can use to contact attorneys for initial consultations.

Would you like me to find top-rated truck-accident lawyers in Dallas and provide a short list? If so, tell me your ZIP code or where in Dallas the accident occurred, and any special needs (e.g., severe injuries, wrongful death).
